models.reason: 20T 机器运行门通过；已修复 Qwen2 ChatML 模板接线，64/128/192 token 长输出均实际跑满，256 token 仍触发 worker fail-closed，页面上限保持 192。
models.technical_detail: 20T completed artifact, Ascend placement, JSON/SSE, 64-token, stability and performance gates. On 2026-10-18 a tokenizer bundle without tokenizer_config.json was found to fall back to a Qwen1.5-shaped template. The reviewed ChatML template was bound to the profile; 64/128/192-token long outputs then reached length without U+FFFD or role-marker leakage. A fresh 256-token run still exited fail-closed with TBE subprocess diagnostics, so this profile remains capped at 192.
models.quality_detail: Post-template 20T long-output runs have clean UTF-8 and no role-marker leakage. Chinese semantic quality still requires an independent human review of complete responses.
